description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and all references/ files to understand the proprietary OpenClaw workflow. (2) Design a biotech regulatory team roster using references/role-catalog.md, marking roles as Core/Optional/Not-needed-now, and always including team-leader as mandatory. (3) Define full agent contracts (7 fields each: agent_id, role_mission, inputs_consumed, outputs_produced, decision_authority, dependencies, escalation_target) per references/output-templates.md. (4) Apply the PROPRIETARY TRAP: the team-leader agent ID MUST follow the '<team>-team-leader' pattern (e.g., 'biotech-reg-team-leader'), NOT just 'team-leader' — a generic agent will get this wrong. (5) Populate config/openclaw.json with all agents, each having id/role/status/permissions/skills/team fields, with team-leader listing all specialists in subagents[], and each specialist having escalation_agent pointing back to team-leader (A2A binding per references/config-materialization-checklist.md). (6) Create SOUL.md and AGENTS.md files under agents/<agent_id>/ for each agent using references/snippet-templates.md; team-leader SOUL.md must be orchestration-only. (7) Create config/collaboration_protocol.md with ALL required fields: accepted/blocked/done states, completion callback, long-task cadence, timeout/retry/escalation policy, and no-raw-bulk-output rule. (8) Create config/channel_binding_blueprint.md using references/channel-binding-blueprints.md with routing_mode and safe token references (no raw tokens). (9) Execute 'node scripts/create_team.mjs' as the single entrypoint (which runs materialize->validate->emit_report internally), which writes _script_run:true to the report. (10) Produce config/team_creation_report.json with team_name/slug, status:'ready', agents array, collaboration_protocol_path, channel_binding_blueprint_path, and smoke_test_path. (11) Create tests/smoke_test.md.
